to.shell_command: printf '%s\ts\tn\n' "$(date +%FT%T)" >> /Users/xein/.local/state/karabiner/usage.log; if pgrep -qx MenuBarAgent; then osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell process "MenuBarAgent"' -e 'repeat with g in every group of menu bar 1' -e 'set mi to menu bar item 1 of g' -e 'if (value of attribute "AXIdentifier" of mi) is "com.apple.menuextra.clock" then perform action "AXPress" of mi' -e 'end repeat' -e 'end tell'; else osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell process "ControlCenter"' -e 'repeat with mi in every menu bar item of menu bar 1' -e 'if (value of attribute "AXIdentifier" of mi) is "com.apple.menuextra.clock" then perform action "AXPress" of mi' -e 'end repeat' -e 'end tell'; fi
printf '%s\ts\tv\n' "$(date +%FT%T)" >> /Users/xein/.local/state/karabiner/usage.log; if pgrep -xq 'Audio Hijack'; then osascript -e 'quit app "Audio Hijack"'; else open -a 'Audio Hijack.app'; fi
